text: Every man hurries through his life, and... suffers from a yearning for the future, and a weariness of the present: but he who disposes of all his time for his own purposes, who arranges all his days as though he were arranging the plan of his life, neither wishes for nor fears the morrow.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
locator: Of the Shortness of Life, Chapter 7
